pairs.prompt:
Which is a better approach to climate change?
A) Gradual, market-based solutions — carbon taxes, innovation incentives
B) Radical immediate action — ban fossil fuels, restructure the economy

Is regulated hunting a good thing?
A) Yes — it's an effective conservation tool and connects people with nature
B) No — it's just a justification for killing animals for fun

Should 'green growth' — growing the economy while reducing emissions — be the goal?
A) Yes — we can have both prosperity and a healthy planet through innovation
B) No — we need economic degrowth to truly save the planet

Which should we prioritize?
A) Nuclear energy — it's clean, reliable, and proven
B) Only renewables like solar and wind — nuclear is too risky

Which is a better approach to autonomous weapons?
A) AI should never make kill decisions — humans must always be in the loop
B) AI weapons could actually reduce civilian casualties by being more precise

Which is a better approach to genetic engineering of human embryos?
A) Allow it cautiously — preventing genetic diseases is worth pursuing
B) Ban it — we shouldn't be engineering humans, it's a slippery slope to eugenics

Has social media been good for society?
A) No — it's addictive, divisive, and destroying real human connection
B) Yes — it democratizes information, connects people, and enables activism

What should we do about tipping culture?
A) Keep it — it rewards good service and lets workers earn more
B) Abolish it — pay workers a fair wage instead of relying on customer generosity

Are teacher unions good for education?
A) No — they mainly protect bad teachers and block needed reform
B) Yes — they advocate for fair pay and working conditions which benefits students too

Which is a better attitude toward sports?
A) Competitive sports like MMA and boxing have genuine value — they build character
B) They're glorified violence that we should move past as a society

Is national identity healthy or exclusionary?
A) Healthy — it gives people a sense of belonging and shared purpose
B) Exclusionary — it divides people and leads to xenophobia

Which approach to water is better?
A) Water can be privately managed and traded — markets allocate resources efficiently
B) Water is a human right that should never be privately owned or commodified

Which is better?
A) Guns as a hobby — target shooting, collecting, craftsmanship
B) Guns should be minimized in society — the hobby normalizes dangerous weapons

How should we view Karl Marx?
A) A dangerous ideologue whose ideas led to totalitarianism and mass death
B) A prophetic analyst of capitalism's flaws whose critique is still relevant

Should comedians be able to joke about anything?
A) Yes — nothing should be off-limits, comedy needs total freedom
B) No — some topics cause real harm and comedians should be responsible

Is fitness culture — CrossFit, gym obsession — healthy?
A) Yes — discipline, strength, and self-improvement are admirable values
B) No — it's often narcissistic body obsession disguised as wellness

Is fluoride in public water a good policy?
A) No — it's government overreach to medicate the water supply without consent
B) Yes — it's a proven public health measure that prevents tooth decay

Is patriotism a good thing?
A) Yes — love of country gives people purpose and binds communities together
B) No — it's a bias that leads to tribalism and conflict

Is the decline of community involvement a real problem?
A) Yes — the loss of churches, clubs, and local organizations is tearing the social fabric
B) No — people are finding connection in new ways online and through different communities

Should cash bail exist?
A) Yes — it ensures people show up for trial and protects public safety
B) No — it punishes poverty and keeps innocent people locked up because they're poor

Is the rise in mental health diagnoses a good thing?
A) No — we're over-medicalizing normal human emotions and creating a victim culture
B) Yes — we're finally recognizing and treating problems that were always there

Which is a better approach to alternative medicine?
A) There's real value in acupuncture, herbal remedies, and traditional practices
B) It's mostly quackery — stick with evidence-based medicine

Is the space industry better off privatized?
A) Yes — SpaceX proves private companies are faster and more innovative
B) No — space exploration should serve humanity, not billionaires' egos

Which approach to vaccines is better?
A) Parents should always have the right to refuse — medical freedom is fundamental
B) Vaccine mandates for public schools — herd immunity protects everyone

Is organic food genuinely better?
A) No — it's mostly a marketing premium for affluent people feeling virtuous
B) Yes — it's healthier and better for the environment

Which is a better view of pickup trucks?
A) Practical and iconic — they're useful and represent independence
B) Excessive and wasteful — most people don't need that much vehicle

Is it wrong for a CEO to earn 300 times what the average worker makes?
A) No — the market determines pay, and executives create enormous value
B) Yes — that level of inequality is morally indefensible

Is there anything wrong with wanting to preserve your national language?
A) No — a shared language unites a country and preserves culture
B) Yes — language purism is often a cover for hostility toward immigrants

Were COVID lockdowns the right call?
A) No — they caused more harm than the virus, especially to the economy and mental health
B) Yes — they saved lives and were a necessary public health measure

Should private prisons exist?
A) Yes — they're more efficient than government-run facilities
B) No — profiting from imprisonment creates a perverse incentive to lock people up

Is grade inflation a real problem?
A) Yes — lowering standards cheats students and devalues achievement
B) No — it reflects a broader, more inclusive approach to education

How should we view the robber barons — Carnegie, Rockefeller, Vanderbilt?
A) Great builders who created industries and lifted the economy
B) Exploiters who crushed workers and competitors to amass obscene wealth

How should we view the Confederacy?
A) They were fighting for states' rights and local self-governance
B) They were fighting to preserve slavery — that's the central cause, full stop

Can organic farming feed the world?
A) No — we need industrial agriculture despite its costs; organic can't scale
B) Yes — with proper investment, sustainable farming can meet global needs

Is free speech on college campuses under threat?
A) Yes — cancel culture and political correctness are silencing legitimate debate
B) No — people are just being asked to be more respectful and inclusive

Are heritage languages worth preserving?
A) Yes — they carry culture, history, and identity that would be lost otherwise
B) Not really — if everyone speaks the dominant language, minority languages are a nostalgia project

Should legacy admissions — preference for children of alumni — continue?
A) Yes — alumni connections and donations strengthen institutions for everyone
B) No — it's unfair privilege that undermines meritocratic admissions

Should children always obey their parents?
A) Yes — parental authority is the foundation of a well-ordered family
B) No — children should learn to think for themselves and challenge bad decisions
